WIFE FROM THE 2ND OF UPAPADA (up to shloka 22): If a planet being constant indicator of wife (i.e. 7th lord or Venus) is in own house, there will be loss of wife only at a later stage. If the lord of Upapada or the constant significator of wife is in exaltation, the wife will be from a noble family; reverse will be the case, if he is debilitated.
